title: Well-Posedness of the Helmholtz Equation with Rough Coefficients
summary: We establish the well-posedness of the Helmholtz equation with rough and compactly supported coefficients in Rd under sharp regularity assumptions. Using a paraproduct calculus in rescaled weighted Besov spaces, we rigorously define the product between the solution and the coefficient at the lowest regularity level without renormalization. A rescaled Lippmann-Schwinger formulation is shown to be equivalent to the Helmholtz equation with the Sommerfeld radiation condition.
